column1: # `overworld.md §8` "Surface chasm/falls" row and `§6.2.4`: the falls chain
# checks each living member once - the shared skewed `1..30` roll, damage when
# Dexterity is **less than or equal to** it - and the shared party-damage
# helper "performs a complete stats-panel repaint ... an **immediate**
# repaint made by the helper itself as its last act".
# `overworld-falls` cannot measure that repaint reliably: its Avatar has
# Dexterity 30, so a hit needs the roll's top value, and either side may or
# may not draw it on a given run (its header has the 2026-10-25 runs).
# This seed is `seed-overworld-falls` with the Avatar's Dexterity byte set to
# 1, which every roll meets: both sides must take exactly one point, so the
# panel is deterministic and every beat compares the moment it repaints.
# Measured 2026-10-25 (20261025-080216): both sides read `59G` at every
# beat - the stock panel repaints within the falls turn, as Q11 has it.
# requires-seed: seed-overworld-falls with the Avatar's Dexterity set to 1
